effect.name: Photoshop Darken (Background)
effect.description: (The effect comes from the Photoshop) Looks at the color information in each channel and selects the base or blend color - whichever is darker - as the result color. Pixels lighter than the blend color are replaced, and pixels darker than the blend color do not change
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.
